subcategory_text: Removable media is protected and its use restricted according to policy.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: MP-2 (Media Access), MP-4 (Media Storage), MP-7 (Media Use)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.8.10, A.7.10 (Storage media handling)
implementation_examples: Protect removable media and restrict its use to authorised purposes (e.g., encrypted USB only, no personal devices, automatic media scanning)
Capture disposal events for media containing personal data
assessment_objectives: Determine whether removable-media controls exist (encryption, scan, tracking)
Determine whether media use is restricted to authorised purposes
Determine whether media issuance and return are tracked
